title: Consolidate release notes workflow, localization pipeline, and GTM checklist
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Release notes for Redwood Inference frequently diverge between internal release summaries, the public changelog, and localized customer-facing translations. PR authors provide inconsistent metadata, which leads to last-minute copy edits, missed translations, and unclear owner sign-offs. Goal: Create a repeatable, auditable release notes workflow that produces a single source-of-truth draft, supports localization handoff, and drives GTM tasks (sales enablement, support memos, dashboard banners) with clear owners and deadlines.
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical release notes draft is generated for each release and stored in Drive/Confluence with a stable filename pattern
Localization tasks are automatically created in the translation board with context and a single point of contact
Stakeholder reviewers (Eng, Design, Security, Sales, Support) complete review within the SLA window or request a documented exception
Public changelog, docs release notes, and customer newsletter content are exported from the canonical draft without manual re-entry
A GTM checklist is associated with the release notes and ticked off before the public announcement
tasks: Design and publish a release notes template (RN-TEMPLATE-3) that includes change type, risk level, owner, PR link, and recommended customer-facing blurb
Add a metadata step to the PR merge checklist: 'add RN metadata: type, risk, blurb, visibility'
Build a small script to parse merged PRs (labels and body tags) into a canonical CSV and push to Drive/Confluence (prototype GH-4512)
Define localization handoff: file format, context notes, images, and string length guidance. Create translation ticket template
Run two pilot releases (next two minor releases) to validate timing and SLAs
Create GTM checklist with owners for: Sales enablement, Support memo, Release blog, Dashboard banner, Changelog page update, Email campaign
stakeholder_reviewers: Noah Ramirez (Design) - UX screenshots and copy
updates: 2026-02-20: Ticket created by Maya Chen. Initial scope and acceptance criteria drafted.
2026-02-25: Met with Eng leads (Amira) and Design (Noah) to gather template requirements. Agreed on fields: change_type, impact, owner, PR, blurb, localization_context.
2026-03-02: Prototype CSV parser (GH-4512) generates canonical draft from merged PRs. Script still needs image/context handling.
2026-03-04: Security asked for dedicated compliance blurb field; added to template.
2026-03-06: Draft GTM checklist created and reviewed by Sales and Support. Sales requested CTA examples and customer segment tagging.
2026-03-10: Decided on pilot cadence: next two minor releases (2026.03.2 and 2026.04.1). Assigned localization lead: Ana Ruiz. Action: finalize translation handoff by 2026-03-17.
qa_checks: All PRs referenced in the canonical draft have correct labels and PR links
Localized strings exist for en, fr, de, ja, and es for all public-facing blurbs
Screenshots used in notes have alt text and match released UI
GTM checklist items assigned and have owners with due dates
risks: Translations may arrive after scheduled publish time — mitigation: gated publish with 'translations complete' flag or fallback to English
PR authors don't add metadata — mitigation: add CI reminder and make metadata a required merge checklist item
Last-minute engineering bug fix changes scope — mitigation: freeze release notes 24 hours before publish and require explicit change approval
next_steps: Finalize RN-TEMPLATE-3 and publish to Confluence by 2026-03-12
Wire the CSV parser into a nightly job to populate canonical draft by 2026-03-15
Handoff localization package to Ana Ruiz on 2026-03-17
Run pilot for 2026.03.2 release, collect feedback, and iterate on the template and GTM checklist
